basic_info.description: Mixed-Use Building zoned NC-2 at the corner of Pacific & Hyde with excellent presence along the Hyde Street cable car line. Two Residential Flats over a corner grocery store + FOUR CAR PARKING.    The Top Floor 3BR 2BA flat is VACANT and has been nicely updated with skylights and in-unit laundry. The Middle unit is 3BR 1BA and tenant occupied (protected) $1070 per month. The corner market at 1600 Hyde Street pays $2400 month to month. This is a fabulous opportunity to start a new business where many new cafe's, wine bars and restaurants have recently opened. The garage level features fire sprinklers and steel upgrades. New roof in 2024 with Golden Gate Bridge Views from unwarranted roof deck.
